$comment: Copy to docs/design-contract.json and fill in. Written by the Design agent;
consumed by the Planner, Execution, Visual QA and `yuva gate` (the
design-contract plugin gate). This is the half of the design system that must
not be re-interpreted: paths, token names, the inventory, the a11y target.
It lives in docs/ and not under .yuva/ because enforcement-rules PROTECTED_DIRS
blocks workers from writing beneath .yuva/, so an agent cannot author it there.

paths.$comment: REQUIRED. Nothing hardcodes these — the gate, the lints and every agent read them from here. A Vite app uses src/styles/, Next uses app/ or styles/.

$comment_uiSource: REQUIRED. Application-owned UI source ONLY. This is what makes the colour-literal lint precise instead of a false-positive machine.
$comment_exclude: On top of the always-excluded set (tests, stories, snapshots, vendor, dist, generated, minified). Add project-specific escapes here.
$comment_profile: operations | marketing | consumer. Switches which layout archetypes and signature-detail expectations apply, so an ops console is not pushed toward a marketing language.

a11y.$comment_exceptions: Each exception needs a reason and a mitigation, per componentcontracts C8. An undocumented gap is a defect; a documented one is a decision.

tokens.$comment: Component source may reference SEMANTIC tokens only. A primitive reference hard-codes a ramp position and defeats the token system (componentcontracts section 7.1).

scales.$comment: Literal values the off-scale lint checks against. 0 and 1px are always allowed (hairlines).

components.$comment: Tier 0 primitive | 1 composition | 2 pattern. Only Tier 2 may fetch. Every entry needs a contract file before it is implemented.
components.name: Button

$comment_provisional: Decisions taken as defaults because a question went unanswered (designagent ask-once policy). Each entry says what was assumed and what changes if the real answer differs. An empty list means every decision was made on real input.

acceptance.$comment: What 'done' means for UI work in this project. Checked by Visual QA.
acceptance.contractCoverage: every component in `components` has all twelve sections
acceptance.keyboardOnly: the critical workflow (product brief P3) is completable with no mouse
